lessons.text: Order totals must round half up to whole cents: taxFor and applyPercent both go through roundCents, so a fractional cent never truncates.
Reservations are checked against available units (on hand minus reserved), never against on-hand stock alone.
Money is integer cents everywhere in ts-orders; format with formatMoney only at the edge, in invoices and CLI output.
Each module keeps its tests in tests/<module>.test.ts; add a helper's test to the file of the module that owns it.

decide.title: Orders are stored as one JSON file
decide.body: The order store stays a single JSON file read and written whole by src/store/store.ts. A database waits until orders outgrow what a person can read in an editor, because every report and the CLI load the whole list anyway.
